title: Creatio Developer (Angular / .NET)
description:
About the Company
Sales'Up is a leading Creatio implementation partner, helping enterprise clients across FMCG, Agro, Finance and Pharma transform their business processes. Over 8+ years, we've delivered 100+ successful CRM projects and built our own industry-specific products: Data Management, FMCG Management, and Agro Management — used by market leaders.

 

Role
We are looking for a Creatio Developer with hands-on platform experience to build and enhance CRM solutions for clients across different industries and countries. You'll work directly with the Creatio platform's architecture, configuring business logic, developing custom modules, and shaping solutions that go live on real international projects.

 

Main Responsibilities:

  • Developing and enhancing solutions on the Creatio CRM platform (formerly bpm'online)
  • Configuring business logic, data objects, interfaces, and business processes
  • Developing custom modules, UI components, and integrations
  • Optimizing solution performance and writing efficient SQL queries
  • Participating in the design of Creatio application and module architecture
  • Supporting existing solutions and resolving incidents
  • Working within a development team using Git and CI/CD practices

 

Requirements:

  • 1+ year of hands-on experience with Creatio
  • Commercial development experience with C# / .NET (ASP.NET, Web API, WCF)
  • Confident knowledge of JavaScript (Angular, jQuery, Backbone.js, Ext JS, RequireJS)
  • Experience with SQL (PostgreSQL, MS SQL)
  • Understanding of Creatio platform architecture and internals (Schemas, Packages, Configuration, Data Binding, Process Designer)
  • Layout skills (HTML5, CSS3)
  • Knowledge of SOLID, DRY, KISS principles
  • Ability to work with Git
  • English level – B2

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience integrating Creatio with external systems (REST, SOAP, WCF)
  • Experience with Creatio Mobile
  • Understanding of message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
  • Experience developing custom UI modules (Ext.js / Angular)
  • Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.)
  • Agile/Scrum experience

 

We Offer:

  • Involvement in international Creatio projects
  • Professional growth and certification opportunities
  • Remote/hybrid work options
  • A team of professionals in a friendly atmosphere
